new.name: Grok Bot
new.description: Grok Bot is an AI teammate product from SpaceXAI (formerly xAI) in which each named Bot gets its own persistent cloud computer with a browser, filesystem and terminal. You message Bots like colleagues in the desktop and mobile apps, Slack or Microsoft Teams; they sign in to your apps and websites, including ones with no API, work in parallel around the clock, hand off to each other and ask for approval before sensitive steps. Finished methods can be saved as skills and run as routines on a schedule or when an event arrives. Grok Bot 1.0 left beta on Nov 2, 2026, and it is included in The X Subscription Premium ($30/mo), Super ($100/mo) and Ultra ($200/mo) plans, with Teams seats and Enterprise.
new.pricing_detail: Included with The X Subscription Premium ($30/mo), Super ($100/mo) and Ultra ($200/mo); Teams seats at the same per-seat prices; Enterprise via sales; not in Free or Plus ($8/mo)

new.name: FestiveLooks
new.description: FestiveLooks is an AI holiday photo generator that turns one uploaded photo into seasonal portraits of you, your family, your partner or your pet while keeping faces recognisable. Christmas is live with 20 looks plus tools such as adding Santa to a photo, dog Christmas portraits and a Christmas filter, with New Year, Valentine's Day and other holidays coming. Subscriptions start at $14.99 a month for 100 credits, with full-size watermark-free downloads.

new.name: Tesla Wrap Design
new.description: Tesla Wrap Design is a free browser studio for creating custom wraps for Tesla's Paint Shop feature: you pick one of 12 official vehicle templates, paint with layers, stickers, text and brushes, check the result on a live 3D model and export a PNG to load from a USB drive, all without an account. An optional AI generator turns a text prompt into a wrap design for 10 credits, with credit packs from $4.90 that never expire.

new.name: MOSS-Image Online
new.description: MOSS-Image Online is a hosted web generator for OpenMOSS's open 5B MOSS-Image model, which is known for spelling Chinese and English text correctly inside images such as posters, menus and signs and for following box-level layouts you draw. You describe the picture and the exact words, optionally place elements in a layout editor, and get three free images before one-time credit packs from $4.99; it also links ComfyUI workflows and lets you run on your own Hugging Face quota.

new.name: Oh!Mate
new.description: Oh!Mate is a desktop AI workspace for Windows, macOS and Linux that edits Word documents, Excel spreadsheets and PowerPoint decks for you while leaving untouched content and formatting as it was. Work is organised into project workspaces with your files, sources and chat sessions, and reusable Skills cover tasks such as writing, data cleanup, PDFs, slides, research notes, code and long-form fiction. Free and paid plans are available; an account and internet connection are required.

new.name: SoloPup Memory
new.description: SoloPup Memory is an MIT-licensed text-memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that stores what you tell your coding agent together with the original wording and its source, keeps memories separated by project and records a revision history, so the agent can recall decisions with evidence instead of paraphrased guesses. It is in public beta.

new.name: Duct AI
new.description: Duct is an open-source (MIT) AI marketing agent that acts as a growth analyst with access to all your tools at once. It reads Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, Search Console, Stripe, Mixpanel and other sources together, explains why a number moved across them, and drafts fixes such as pausing or resuming a campaign that only run when you press Apply. It is a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that uses your own model key or an existing ChatGPT plan.

new.name: Kite.new
new.description: Kite is a design canvas where AI agents and people work on the same board: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or another agent you already pay for designs screens, websites and brand assets inside your own design system while teammates edit alongside it. Agent actions show up live on the canvas, and it comes as a web app and a Mac download. The free plan includes unlimited editors and viewers, three files and 200 agent actions a day; Pro is $16 per editor a month billed yearly.

stars.name: REA
stars.description: MCP server and CLI that lets coding agents reverse engineer native binaries, Electron and JavaScript apps, .NET assemblies and live websites, using Ghidra, Hopper or IDA under the hood.

stars.name: OpenClaw
stars.description: OpenClaw is an MIT-licensed personal AI assistant that runs on your own computer and answers in the chat apps you already use, including Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram and WhatsApp, with native apps for macOS, iOS, Android, Windows and Linux. State, memory and credentials stay on your hardware, models and harnesses such as Claude, Codex or local models are swappable plugins, and one gateway can run a personal or shared multiplayer assistant. It is stewarded by the non-profit OpenClaw Foundation with no paid tier or hosted service.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); you pay only for the model providers you connect.

stars.name: ECC
stars.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond

stars.name: DeepSeek Harness
stars.description: DeepSeek's open-source agent harness with a local web UI, built so that every tool, model and scheduled task is a swappable plugin; still a developer preview.

stars.name: Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
stars.description: Hermes Agent is Nous Research's MIT-licensed, self-improving agent with a built-in learning loop: it writes skills from completed tasks, refines them in use, keeps agent-curated memory and searches its own past conversations. It runs on anything from a $5 VPS to serverless infrastructure, offers a full terminal UI, and one gateway serves Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal and the CLI, with any model via Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI or your own endpoint.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); model usage billed by your chosen provider.

stars.name: opencode
stars.description: OpenCode is an MIT-licensed open-source AI coding agent for the terminal, with a beta desktop app, that works with many model providers instead of locking you to one. Install it with a one-line script, npm, Homebrew, pacman, mise or Nix, then let it read your repository, edit files and run commands from a keyboard-driven TUI.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); bring your own model provider.

stars.name: n8n
stars.description: Workflow automation with AI agent nodes; self-host or cloud.

stars.name: Firecrawl
stars.description: Firecrawl is an AGPL-3.0 web data API for AI agents, open source and available as a hosted service: Search returns full page content for web results, Scrape turns any URL into clean Markdown, HTML, screenshots or structured JSON, Crawl and Map cover whole sites, Interact clicks, scrolls and types before extracting, and Parse converts PDFs and DOCX files. It handles proxies, rate limits and JavaScript-heavy pages for you, and connects to any agent or MCP client with a single command.
